thread:
jane: Kicking off a targeted staging soak for quota enforcement — 4h, hitting per-org and per-key buckets. Goal: validate burst token behaviour and dashboard telemetry. Starting in 5m. Test plan: k6 -> /v1/generate at ~1k rps peak, mix of per-key and per-org traffic. Tagging @maya @sam for telemetry + infra. Will probably reduce staging burst tokens to 50 for this run. Link: https://go/repo/staging-soak
sam: Ack. Recommend client retries off and add a small random jitter to request timestamps so we exercise token refill edges. Will also attach a minimal k6 snippet.
jane: will add X-test-run header and unique request ids so we can filter in logs.
maya: please include X-test-run: soak-2026-03-17 and X-req-id. I'll create dashboards for per-key token usage and 429/503 tails.
sam: example k6 snippet:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function () {
  http.post('https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'test'}), {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${__ENV.KEY}`, 'X-test-run': 'soak-2026-03-17', 'X-req-id': `${__VU}-${__ITER}` }
  });
}
```
leo: can we get a temporary dashboard tab that shows per-route 50/95/99 latency, 429 rate, and token_bucket_watermark? PM wants screenshots for the run.
maya: creating the dashboard now. Adding panels: per-key token usage, token_bucket_fill_rate, per-route lat P50/P95, 429/sec, 503/sec. Enabling 1% trace sampling to link traces.
infra-bot: deploy-bot started job staging/load-generator/soak-1768123456
maya: 10m in — seeing a noisy org (org-pty-42) spike and its burst tokens go to 0 within ~30s; a lot of 429s. Sample header observed: x-rate-limit-limit: 100, x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 28
sam: can you paste a short proxy log line for one of the 429s?
maya: log: `proxy=ingress node=frontend req_id=abc123 key=org-pty-42 status=429 code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED burst_tokens=0` — correlates with the per-key panel.
jane: pause the special spike generator for org-pty-42 for 5m; want to observe system-level behavior without that noisy tenant dominating.
infra-bot: load job paused by jane
maya: after pausing, 429 rate drops to baseline. We're still seeing sporadic 503s from downstream under sustained ~1k rps — looks like autoscaler lag or worker saturation. 503 responses have header x-service-downstream: true
sam: 503s inline with worker saturation. Suggest increasing frontend worker pool by 20% in staging and shortening token bucket refill interval to 1s (more granular refill) to smooth burst behavior.
jane: ok plan: (1) bump workers + adjust refill interval, (2) rerun a 2h soak with 5% cross-org noise, (3) capture dashboard screenshots and traces, (4) validate counters vs billing events. @leo please prepare screenshots and a short post-run note.
leo: will do. prepping a short template for the write-up and screenshot checklist.
maya: +1. After rerun I'll run a quick script to diff per-key counters against billing emit (script: billing_diff.sh) and validate no double-counting.
jane: Thanks all :thumbsup: Summary: started soak, noisy org exhausted burst tokens -> paused generator -> observed 503s likely due to worker lag -> plan config changes and rerun. I'll reopen thread with rerun results.
